newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex to auction floating crude storage site.
newsitem.headline: Pemex to auction floating crude storage site.

text.p: Mexican oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) plans to award a concession shortly for a floating crude oil storage site in the Campeche Sound, Pemex sources said on Monday.

The government had announced the project last February, when the Official Gazette said Pemex would award a concession to design and construct a 1.65 million barrel capacity floating storage and offloading site with underwater piping.
The concession for the site will be for 15 years with an option to buy, the gazette said.
The Pemex sources have said the investment could be about $165 million.
Pemex spokesmen would not comment on the concession.
